description: Take one event and return the exact arguments for the time-tracker's entry_add, so a meeting that already happened becomes billable time without retyping it. Writes nothing: pass the JSON straight to entry_add.

currency.description: Currency of the rate: EUR, USD, GBP, PLN, or the word the user said ('euros'). Without it the time-tracker falls back to USD.

event_id.description: Event id from events_list, events_search or next_event

project.description: Project or client the meeting is billed to

rate.description: Hourly rate for this entry; a number (120) or the words the user said ('120 euros an hour')

name: event_to_time_entry
title: Turn a meeting into a time entry
